mechanism: The creation of the US presidency in 1789 required an official executive residence, which the White House provides.
Relocating the federal government to Washington, D.C. created the need for a dedicated executive mansion in the new capital.
Fleming's valve was developed to detect radio signals in wireless telegraphy, producing the first thermionic diode.
Thermionic valves such as diodes and triodes became the switching elements of early electronic computers.
Golden Horde troops besieging Caffa in 1346 and Mongol trade routes carried plague into Europe.
Hertz's confirmation of electromagnetic waves validated Maxwell's electrodynamics, the theory special relativity reconciled with mechanics.
Japan modeled its Taiho Code of 701 on Tang legal codes and administration, adopting the Tang governance model.
A Tang military alliance with Silla defeated Goguryeo and Baekje, enabling Silla to unify most of the Korean peninsula.
Julius Caesar commissioned Sosigenes to reform the Roman calendar, establishing the 365.25-day Julian year in 46 BC.
Pharaoh Khufu commissioned the Great Pyramid as his royal tomb, mobilizing the state labour force that built it.
Djoser's Step Pyramid of the Third Dynasty established the monumental stone pyramid form that Khufu's architects developed into the Great Pyramid.
The Soviet RBMK reactor design and a secretive, test-driven operating culture set up the 1986 explosion at Chernobyl.
Firearms and artillery powered by gunpowder gave the Ottomans military advantages that supported their conquests.
Internal combustion engines powered the tanks, trucks and aircraft that mechanized and accelerated World War II.
The breakup of Yugoslavia left Serbia and Montenegro as the rump federation, which it succeeded in 2003.
The founding of West Germany in 1949 prompted the Soviet occupation zone to be organized as the German Democratic Republic later that year.
Daguerreotype photography pushed painters toward capturing transient light and colour, an influence on the Impressionists.
Darwin's theory of natural selection, presented with Wallace in 1858 and published in 1859, became the foundation of evolutionary biology.
